text.p: Ciba Specialty Chemicals said it signed a letter of intent to exchange its PVC heat stabilisers business for Witco Corp's epoxy systems and adhesives business in a one-for-one transaction.
Each business had 1996 sales of approximately 180 million Swiss francs, Ciba said.
It said the companies expect to complete the transaction, which is subject to regulatory approvals and a definitive agreement, in late 1997.
Witco's worldwide epoxy systems and adhesives business is based in Bergkamen, Germany and has minor production facilities in Singapore and Italy.

Ciba's PVC heat stabiliser business is headquartered in Lampertheim, Germany. This transaction includes the tin, mixed metal, non-metallic stabilisers, epoxy plasticisers and lubricants for PVC and other PVC stabilisers, Ciba also said. -- Zurich Editorial +41 1 631 7340
